steps.script: var sec = document.querySelector('#concept-__panel-CrossDockingConsolePanel__'); var inputs = Array.from(sec.querySelectorAll('.declared-panel-action-inputs input')); var values = { recebimentoId: '86f3658f-347d-422d-b951-a355f7a889ea', expedicaoId: '023a3fff-aae0-4e33-b7cb-c2164b63812b', produtoId: '47a83a5c-96c2-4fe8-99df-84d052e90806', quantidade: '7', dataAtivacao: '2026-07-29' }; inputs.forEach(function(inp){ if (values[inp.placeholder] !== undefined) { inp.value = values[inp.placeholder]; } }); var btns = Array.from(sec.querySelectorAll('button')); var btn = btns.find(function(b){ return b.textContent.indexOf('Ativar') !== -1; }); if (!btn) return 'BUTTON_NOT_FOUND'; btn.click(); return 'filled-and-clicked:' + inputs.length + '-inputs';
